title: Signal: ASP.NET Core developer exception page disclosed in a response

check.valuePattern: (?=[\s\S]*An unhandled exception occurred while processing the request)(?=[\s\S]*Microsoft\.AspNetCore)

scope: One response whose body contains the developer exception heading and a Microsoft.AspNetCore reference.
limitations: Two body markers. A generic ASP.NET stack trace without the developer page heading is reported by the .NET stack-frame rule instead.

observation.body:
An unhandled exception occurred while processing the request.

InvalidOperationException: boom at Microsoft.AspNetCore.Diagnostics.DeveloperExceptionPageMiddleware
An unhandled exception occurred while processing the request. See Microsoft.AspNetCore.Server.Kestrel output.

fpNotes: An error page rendered by a custom handler that keeps the heading for support purposes is reported; the page still exposes the exception.
